description: Command-line interface for Toggly feature flag management. Supports interactive device-code login and CI client credentials.

commands.description: Manage interactive authentication
Log in with the OAuth2 device-code flow. Stores the session in the OS credential store (macOS Keychain, Windows Credential Manager, or Linux libsecret).

options.name: --authority
options.description: OAuth2 authority URL (defaults to https://auth.toggly.io)

options.name: --client-id
options.description: Public device client id (defaults to toggly-cli)

options.name: --scopes
options.description: OAuth scopes (defaults to 'openid toggly offline_access')

commands.description: Remove the stored device-code session from the OS credential store.

commands.description: Create a new feature definition. First-class filter options (--enable, --percentage, --targeting-*, --time-window-*) require --environment and are validated/merged with --environment-filters via the standard filter catalog.

options.name: --app, --application-id
options.description: Application id (or set via 'toggly context set --app')

options.name: --name
options.description: Feature display name (required)

options.name: --feature-key
options.description: Feature key used as the application reference (required)

options.name: --description
options.description: Feature description

options.name: --category
options.description: Feature category

options.name: --tags
options.description: Comma-separated list of tags

options.name: --environment-filters
options.description: JSON object mapping environment names to filter arrays, validated against the standard filter catalog

options.name: --environment
options.description: Environment name to apply first-class filter options to (required when any filter-builder option is set)

options.name: --enable
options.description: Build an AlwaysOn filter for --environment

options.name: --percentage
options.description: Build a Percentage filter with this rollout value (0-100) for --environment

options.name: --targeting-users
options.description: Comma-separated user ids for a Targeting filter

options.name: --targeting-groups
options.description: Comma-separated group names for a Targeting filter

options.name: --targeting-default-rollout
options.description: Targeting filter default rollout percentage (0-100)

options.name: --targeting-ignore-case
options.description: Targeting filter: ignore case when matching users/groups

options.name: --time-window-start
options.description: Build a TimeWindow filter starting at this ISO-8601 timestamp

options.name: --time-window-end
options.description: Build a TimeWindow filter ending at this ISO-8601 timestamp

options.name: --variants
options.description: JSON array of variants, e.g. [{"name":"Control","configurationValue":false}]

options.name: --allocation
options.description: JSON allocation object, e.g. {"percentile":[{"variant":"Control","from":0,"to":50}]}

examples: toggly-cli feature create --app <app-id> --name "New Feature" --feature-key new-feature --environment Production --percentage 25

commands.description: Update an existing feature definition's metadata, variants, and allocation. --filters / --enable / --percentage / --targeting-* / --time-window-* set the definition-level base filters used when provisioning new environments; per-environment overrides are set via 'feature update-environment'.

options.name: --app, --application-id
options.description: Application id (or set via 'toggly context set --app')

options.name: --feature-key
options.description: Feature key to update (required)

options.name: --name
options.description: Feature display name

options.name: --description
options.description: Feature description

options.name: --category
options.description: Feature category

options.name: --tags
options.description: Comma-separated list of tags

options.name: --variants
options.description: JSON array of variants, e.g. [{"name":"Control","configurationValue":false}]

options.name: --allocation
options.description: JSON allocation object, e.g. {"percentile":[{"variant":"Control","from":0,"to":50}]}

options.name: --filters
options.description: JSON array of filter objects, validated against the standard filter catalog, set as the definition-level base filters

options.name: --enable
options.description: Build an AlwaysOn base filter

options.name: --percentage
options.description: Build a Percentage base filter with this rollout value (0-100)

options.name: --targeting-users
options.description: Comma-separated user ids for a Targeting base filter

options.name: --targeting-groups
options.description: Comma-separated group names for a Targeting base filter

options.name: --targeting-default-rollout
options.description: Targeting base filter default rollout percentage (0-100)

options.name: --targeting-ignore-case
options.description: Targeting base filter: ignore case when matching users/groups

options.name: --time-window-start
options.description: Build a TimeWindow base filter starting at this ISO-8601 timestamp

options.name: --time-window-end
options.description: Build a TimeWindow base filter ending at this ISO-8601 timestamp

commands.description: Update feature configuration on a specific environment. Combine --enable, --percentage, --targeting-*, --time-window-*, and/or --filters (validated via the standard filter catalog), or specify --disable alone.

options.name: --app, --application-id
options.description: Application id (or set via 'toggly context set --app')

options.name: --environment, --env
options.description: Environment name (e.g., Production, Staging)

options.name: --feature-key
options.description: Feature key (required)

options.name: --enable
options.description: Enable the feature (sets AlwaysOn filter)

options.name: --disable
options.description: Disable the feature (removes all filters; cannot combine with other filter options)

options.name: --percentage
options.description: Build a Percentage filter with this rollout value (0-100)

options.name: --targeting-users
options.description: Comma-separated user ids for a Targeting filter

options.name: --targeting-groups
options.description: Comma-separated group names for a Targeting filter

options.name: --targeting-default-rollout
options.description: Targeting filter default rollout percentage (0-100)

options.name: --targeting-ignore-case
options.description: Targeting filter: ignore case when matching users/groups

options.name: --time-window-start
options.description: Build a TimeWindow filter starting at this ISO-8601 timestamp

options.name: --time-window-end
options.description: Build a TimeWindow filter ending at this ISO-8601 timestamp

options.name: --filters
options.description: JSON array of filter objects, validated against the standard filter catalog and merged with any filter-builder options

examples: toggly-cli feature update-environment --app <app-id> --env Production --feature-key new-feature --targeting-users alice,bob --targeting-default-rollout 10

commands.description: Associate a CI build with a release.

options.name: --project-key
options.description: Application ID or name (required)

options.name: --environment, --env
options.description: Environment name (e.g., Production, Staging)

options.name: --ci-provider
options.description: CI provider (e.g., azure-devops, github, gitlab, jenkins, circleci) (required)

options.name: --run-id
options.description: CI run/build ID (required)

options.name: --run-url
options.description: URL to view the build in the CI system

options.name: --pipeline-name
options.description: Name of the pipeline/workflow (required)

options.name: --branch
options.description: Git branch name

options.name: --commit-sha
options.description: Git commit SHA

options.name: --build-number
options.description: Build number/version

options.name: --mode
options.description: Mode for finding/creating release (default: use-latest-draft-or-create)

options.name: --release-template-key
options.description: Release template key to use when creating a new release

options.name: --name-pattern
options.description: Name pattern for release (Handlebars-style: ${branch}, ${buildNumber}, ${commitSha})

examples: toggly-cli release associate-build --project-key <app-id> --env Production --ci-provider github --run-id 123456 --pipeline-name deploy-production

commands.description: Import feature flags from other platforms into Toggly

Import an Unleash export or Admin API feature list into a Toggly app and environment. Default is dry-run (compatibility report only); pass --apply to create missing features and set environment filters.

options.name: --file
options.description: Path to Unleash export JSON (or Admin API features payload)

options.name: --app, --application-id
options.description: Application id (or set via 'toggly context set --app')

options.name: --environment, --env
options.description: Toggly environment to import into (also selects Unleash environment slices when present)

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Parse and print a compatibility report without API mutations (default when --apply is omitted)

options.name: --apply
options.description: Create missing features and set environment filters via the Toggly API (does not require a prior dry-run)

commands.description: Manage non-secret default application and environment prefs
